data.name: FreeState: San Francisco
data.detailed_description:
FreeState: San Francisco is a free-to-play open-world driving sandbox that lets you explore a detailed recreation inspired by the streets, hills, highways and coastline of San Francisco. Jump behind the wheel of a growing collection of vehicles, from everyday sedans and sports cars to buses, trucks and more, each with its own handling and performance.

Freely cruise through the city, discover scenic viewpoints, drive across famous bridges, navigate busy downtown streets or simply enjoy relaxing drives through the surrounding districts. Whether you're looking for a casual driving experience or exciting challenges, FreeState: San Francisco offers something for every type of driver.

Take part in a variety of unique Experiences, including police pursuits, police escapes, races, taxi jobs, bus routes, truck deliveries and additional activities that will continue expanding through future updates. Earn in-game money by completing these experiences to unlock new vehicles and grow your collection.

FreeState is designed to keep growing over time with new vehicles, gameplay features, experiences and improvements based on community feedback. The game focuses on accessible driving, smooth vehicle controls and giving players the freedom to explore the city however they choose.

Players looking to expand their garage even further can purchase the optional Premium Upgrade, which permanently unlocks exclusive vehicles, additional experiences and future premium content. The base game remains completely free to play, with no subscription required.

Start your engine, explore San Francisco, and experience the freedom to drive your own way in FreeState: San Francisco.

data.short_description: FreeState: San Francisco is a free-to-play open-world driving game where you can explore a city inspired by San Francisco behind the wheel of a wide variety of vehicles. Cruise through downtown streets, highways, hills and scenic coastal roads while discovering everything the city has to offer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD required. Low graphics settings recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Specifications target 1080p gameplay.
